name: Checkbox

knownIssues.summary: The group's description and error text are `body-md` while Field's message is `body-sm`, so the legend (now Field's label style) is smaller than its own description.

knownLimitations: Wrapping a single Checkbox in Field replaces its own label as its name; give it its own errorMessage instead.
purpose: Select one or more independent options.
behaviorRules: Inside a disabled <fieldset>, the native control is disabled without the disabled prop, and the component looks and behaves exactly as with disabled (its disabled styling also keys off :disabled, via :has() on the wrapper).
A disabled CheckboxGroup disables every checkbox inside it, from options or children, and they look disabled.

errorMessage on a single Checkbox renders the message under the box (body-md, content-error, spacing-xs above), outside the label, adds its id to aria-describedby after any existing description, and marks the checkbox invalid (aria-invalid and the error color). The label and message are then wrapped in a div that takes className.
required on CheckboxGroup shows an aria-hidden * after the legend and adds hidden requiredLabel text to the group's name; it doesn't make any checkbox natively required.
contentRules: The required * appears after the label or legend and is aria-hidden; the native required attribute (Checkbox) or the hidden requiredLabel text (Checkbox Group) is what's announced.
responsiveRules: CheckboxGroup is vertical by default with no gap between options; horizontal puts spacing-lg between options and wraps (no Figma Checkbox Group exists, so this is a code decision).
